notes.title: Our Third Game - Lust For Lucre!
notes.notes:
Howdy, you lusty adventurers you!

We've been working on our third game, Lust For Lucre, for a while now, and finally have released the steam page for the game. If this seems familiar, we were initially set to release this game several years ago, but the game was shelved, but we've revived it and are actively working on it again.

The game is a much different kind of game from Drumpf or Drumpf 2, and is generally apolitical in nature, but will instead be focused on your character exploring a fantasy land, romancing the 14 maidens of the land, [i][b]gaining their tokens of affection[/b][/i], and stripping a whole bunch of saucy monsters.

You can check it out here if you are interested!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1079290/Lust_For_Lucre/]Lust For Lucre | Wishlist Today![/url]

notes.title: Drumpf 2: Lost, But Not Forgotten! release date!
notes.notes:
Howdy y'all!

Looks like we're locked and loaded for release on July 15th at 9:00 AM PDT. Tell your friends, tell your bishop, tell your priest! Don't tell your parents!

notes.title: The Final Sack Tap!
notes.notes: So the 8th didn't work either. Steam keeps rejecting our store page (even though it's currently up). We're shooting an actual release date of the 15th of July. Stay tuned, and thanks for being understanding and stuff! Tiddies ahoy!

notes.title: Drumpf 2 Updated Release Date
notes.notes: Just kidding about the 4th of July thing, I guess. It looks like the earliest release date that we can release has been pushed back to the 8th of July. When we're ready (and able) to release, we'll release the game!

notes.title: Drumpf 2 Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hey all,

We finally got around to making Drumpf 2. It'll be released (tentatively) on July 4th, which is only a week and a half or so away! The store page is up right now, and we're looking to make a super awesome launch video for the game. It should be a bit more boobylicious than Drumpf, so check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1039290/Drumpf_2_Lost_But_Not_Forgotten/

notes.title: Drumpf: Rise Up, Libertonia Artbook released!
notes.notes:
Hello you wonderful people!

The Artbook for Drumpf: Rise Up, Libertonia has finally been released! After being rejected over a year ago by Steam for including "pornographic depictions", they finally eased up and allowed us to upload it for sale!

Additionally, we've finally released the fully nude version of the game as the default version! Enjoy to your heart's content, and stuff. 

As per usual, let me know if you find any bugs or anything.
That is all.

notes.title: Cloud Saving
notes.notes: Hey everybody. Due to popular demand (more than zero people), we have released Cloud Saving! Hopefully it works how it's supposed to! As per usual, let me know if something is horribly broken.

notes.title: Soundtrack now available!
notes.notes:
Hey everybody! Did you enjoy the music for Drumpf: Rise Up, Libertonia!? If so, the soundtrack is also available for purchase now! (It's been ready this entire time, but Steam decided that we can only release DLC between Monday - Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM for some reason. Don't ask me, man.) Feel free to check it out.

Also as a completely unrelated point, how are you guys liking the game? Feedback is always important, and I'm in the dark, here!
